hero.headline: Getting into an Italian university is the easy part.
hero.subhead: Visa, residence permit, fiscal code, municipal registration, health cover, housing — that's the part almost no one warns you about. We handle it with you, step by step.

problemScale.heading: The part after admission is a maze
problemScale.body: Between your acceptance letter and your first day of class, you'll deal with a consulate, a university, a post office, an immigration office, a tax agency, and your local municipality — each with its own deadlines and its own paperwork.

howItWorks.heading: What happens after you press the button
howItWorks.body: No commitment until you decide there is one. Three steps, and you can stop at any of them.

steps.title: You fill in the form
steps.body: Five minutes. You tell us where you are in the process; we work out whether we can actually be useful to you — and say so if we can't.

steps.title: The 15-minute call
steps.body: Not a sales call. We map your situation, name the deadlines that bind you, and tell you which parts you can handle on your own.

steps.title: Your Italian journey begins
steps.body: If you decide to go ahead, we take the paperwork off your desk. You study; we hold the calendar and file everything on time.

trustBuilding.heading: We're new. These institutions are not.
trustBuilding.body: Your path to Italy runs through public bodies with published rules and public deadlines. We don't replace them and we're not accredited by them — we prepare your file for each one and make sure nothing arrives late. Every name below links to its official site, so you can check what we tell you.

institutions.name: Universitaly
institutions.authority: Portal of the Ministry of University and Research
institutions.role: Mandatory pre-registration for non-EU students. We prepare the application and check the documents are the right ones.

institutions.name: CIMEA
institutions.role: The comparability statement for your foreign qualification. We assemble the file and follow the request.

institutions.name: Il visto per l'Italia
institutions.role: The type D study visa is issued by your consulate. We prepare the file to the standard it expects.

institutions.name: Polizia di Stato
institutions.role: The permit must be filed within 8 working days of landing. We prepare the kit and hold that deadline with you.

institutions.name: Agenzia delle Entrate
institutions.role: Your fiscal code — required for a lease, a bank account and health cover. We obtain it with you.

trustBuilding.affiliationNote: To be explicit: Kimere is not affiliated with, accredited by, or acting on behalf of any of these bodies. We list them because they are the institutions you will have to deal with. We prepare the paperwork and keep the deadlines — every decision remains theirs, and no one can promise you its outcome.

finalCta.heading: Talk to us before you apply
finalCta.body: 15 minutes, no cost, no obligation. Tell us where you are in the process and we'll tell you exactly what comes next.
